profile.headline: Software Engineer at The New York Times
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I currently work as a backend software engineer on the Compute and Storage engineering team at The New York Times.

Languages | Python, Typescript, Javascript (Vanilla, React), Scala, Terraform/ HCL, Go, CSS, HTML, GraphQL
Cloud/ Infrastructure | GCP, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker
Version Control/ Tools | Git, Jira

You can find my Github here: https://github.com/ahsunkim

positions.title: Software Engineer (Compute and Storage)
positions.description: Backend software engineer working on building, running and scaling shared compute engines, storage and connective infrastructure that power data transformations.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Privacy Platform)
positions.description:
Fullstack software engineer focused on privacy and governance- building and operating privacy workflows to deliver cross system migrations, building core privacy infrastructure and product workflows based on compliance needs, and setting up reusable governance infrastructure.

- Expanded privacy and consent capabilities - worked on GPP, TCF and geo-gated marketing tracker suppression initiatives across NYT
- Contributed to automated DSR on lakehouse data, including contract discovery and Schema Registry
- Built out Fides DSR automation
- Acted as NYT tech lead for The Athletic privacy migrations - worked on consent and DSR onboarding, including preference migration, identity resolution, and integrations 

Worked with Python, Typescript, JavaScript, Scala, SQL, Terraform/ HCL, GCP, AWS

positions.title: Software Engineer (Targeting Platform)
positions.description:
Backend software engineer on Targeting Platform team - data and infrastructure team behind audience targeting that made shared user data safe, reliable, and usable for targeting and campaign activation across NYT products.

- Maintained internal data product that contains shared user level data models and segment definitions and pipelines that materialized in BigQuery and moved them to activation systems via Census
- Supported internal API, which exposed selected user traits to browser and server clients and helped client teams get data into targeting systems 

Worked with Python, Go, Google Cloud Platform (Bigquery), dbt

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Engineer (Targeting)
positions.description:
Backend software engineer on targeting team - segmentation and product catalog subdivision.

Built graphQL endpoints that allowed fetching of product information to be utilized for a concierge project
Improved one of the most frequently called grpc endpoint owned by the targeting team by batching requests for less redundancy and lower latency
Fixed staging environment for team project to be used for rate limiting testing
Added improved error handling and error monitoring for product catalogs submitted via a public API to improve client experience
Optimized Python scripts querying product information from postgres databases to be utilized for machine learning powered product recommendations and determination of clients’ eligibility of product related text messages
Optimized slow running Python scripts by splitting into several workers via Airflow to reduce runtime by up to 50%
Converted frequently used Python script that replayed events in the DLQ to an airflow script for ease of replayability 
Added capability to fetch PII for subscribers of segments to be utilized for internal CSV downloads
Added time filter capability for url viewed based activity subscriber segments so clients were able to better filter audiences for targeted messages
Successfully handled on call and incident management for the product attribute service

positions.title: Software Engineer (Client Solutions II)
positions.description:
Post sales fullstack software engineer on client solutions team.

Maintained and added features to a Python ETL script utilized by 1000+ clients to generate daily reports of customer activity and corresponding PII
Added improved datadog monitoring to ETL script for ease of identifying which clients had issues with reports
Identified weak points of ETL script and mentored newer engineers on how to properly make additions without breakage on production
Assigned and coordinated JIRA tickets assignment for team
Regularly addressed tickets submitted by clients regarding data collection,
advertisement design and rendering, SQL reporting, SFTP setup, and ESP integrations
Created Slack bot commands for internal teams to securely access/modify data as needed via a
database or an existing API
Mentored newer engineers on team with frequent knowledge shares and documentation updates

positions.title: Software Engineer (Client Solutions I)
positions.description:
Post sales fullstack software engineer on client solutions team.

Maintained and added features to a Python ETL script utilized by 1000+ clients to generate daily reports of customer activity and corresponding PII
Regularly addressed tickets submitted by clients regarding data collection,
advertisement design and rendering, SQL reporting, SFTP setup, and ESP integrations
Created Slack bot commands for internal teams to securely access/modify data as needed via a
database or an existing API
Wrote client configurations using internal DSL for custom data-scraping related to ecommerce
events

positions.title: Software Engineer Immersive Program Student
positions.description: A 17-week immersive software engineering program based in New York City centered on full-stack JavaScript development, including Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL databases, React and Redux along with HTML & CSS, and CS fundamentals.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · React.js · Node.js · PostgreSQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Redux · Express.js

company.name: The Grace Hopper Program at Fullstack Academy

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
A project manager with Scrum Master certification. 

Responsibilities and experiences: Management of the internal project portfolio and resource utilization. Management of the internal marketing team. Management of projects by tracking progress against timelines and milestones with the agile methodology. Prioritization and coordination of tasks across cross-functional team. Communication to clients about project status and potential blockers.

Skills: 
Ability to incorporate scrum methodology for agile projects. 

Ability to utilize project management tools and techniques for successful project completion.

Ability to communicate progress with account executives and stakeholders. 

Ability to manage cross-functional teams and oversee multiple projects for all phases of development. 

Ability to plan, schedule, and monitor progress for project plans and technical implementation and development. 

Ability to compile and produce project status reports and maintain records.

Projects:
Implementation of PWA and AMP for 1800Flowers on Moovweb Platform
Implementation and maintenance of 1800Flowers brands mobile on Moovweb Platform
Implementation of Subscription functionality for Harry & David
Implementation of Fun365 on Magento Platform 
Needs Assessment for OWASP
ADA Compliance for SmileMakers
Page Speed Optimizations for 1800Flowers
Bloomreach SNAP Implementation for Gymboree

positions.description: Mentored and taught a range of subjects including English, Math, and Biology to students from elementary to high school. Facilitated better study habits.

honors.title: James B. Angell Scholar and University Honors
honors.description: Students who achieve an “A” record (all grades of A+, A, or A-) for two or more consecutive terms are recognized as James B. Angell Scholars. The student must have taken a minimum of 14 credit hours each term, including at least 12 credits elected on a graded (A-E) basis. Recipients of this award are recognized during Honors Convocation according to the number of consecutive terms they have earned the Angell Scholar designation. I received this award for 4 consecutive terms of all A's.
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Michigan · Feb 2016

projects.title: Fruity Cats
projects.description:
A mobile application that gamifies teaching players which fruits are harmful or safe for cats. Employs React Native's Animated component to animate player and fruits on the screen and PanResponder to move player based on touch activation.

Developed with React, React-Native, Redux

projects.title: Grace Shopper
projects.description:
A fantasy ecommerce web application “selling dreams and nightmares” that allows users to browse products and view a single product details page. Operates with a persistent cart and functioning checkout for both guests and signed in users.

Developed with Express, Node, React, Redux, Sequelize
Set up persistent cart using user’s session information
Created and hosted CRUD API routes to modify information about users, products, and carts
Added custom express middleware to prevent modifications from unauthorized users

organizations.name: Attentive Women in Engineering (AWE)
organizations.description:
One of the initial committee members of the first and only women in engineering ERG organization at Attentive
Organized social and team building events and interactions
Welcomed new members and maintained AWE members mailing list 
Encouraged slack interactions and promoted Donut coffees
Facilitated connections and open communications via meetups and events

organizations.name: Foundation for the International Medical Relief of Children
organizations.description: Aided in planning fundraising events to raise money to support clinics in underserved countries
